item.title: head
item.description:
• Reorganize Gradle, fdroid, and android skill layout

    Collapse the maven_install_gradle_converter and tools/gradle Starlark layers into flat defs.bzl files per the project-layout skill. Replace the fdroid shell wrapper with a Go binary. Rewrite the Android smoke test as a Go test. Move the android skill from the launcher project to tools/android and register it in the skill discovery map.
